Be Bold. Belong. Be More.

At Southern Cross University, we do things differently, and so can you.

A career with us is more than you might expect. Yes, it’s about the heart, connectedness and community you’d hope for in a regional university. But there’s also so much more. Our game changing Southern Cross Model brings a deeper, focused learning experience and our research is deeply connected to our regions, making a difference on a global scale. This is your chance to help us build something new and meaningful for our students, our communities and your career. To drive change, make a real impact, and thrive in a place as unique as you.

You can be good anywhere. Here, you can be great.

Your opportunity

Southern Cross University is on an ambitious journey to redefine how technology empowers learning, research, and community impact. We’re building a future-ready technology organisation – modern, secure, adaptable, and driven by innovation.  Our teams are embracing emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, to deliver smarter services and real-world benefits for students, staff, and the wider community.

Within Technology Services, our five dynamic work units – Data, Architecture & Integration, Cyber Resilience, Digital Delivery & Innovation, Technology Platforms, and Operations & Services – work collaboratively to deliver high-impact solutions across the University.

We are seeking a Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of complex, enterprise-wide solutions that span multiple systems, platforms, and business domains.  This senior technical role offers the chance to shape architectural direction, establish design standards, and drive strategic solution initiatives across the University’s teaching, learning, research, and administrative functions.

Reporting to the Enterprise Architect, you will work closely with development teams, project managers, and business stakeholders to deliver high-impact solutions aligned with the University’s enterprise architecture vision

You will make an impact by:

  • Designing and delivering robust enterprise-grade solution architectures that support teaching, research, student services, and operations across all major university domains
  • Leading the integration of core platforms such as TechnologyOne, Microsoft Dynamics, Blackboard, Microsoft Teams, and custom applications, ensuring seamless connectivity across all systems
  • Establishing and promoting architectural standards and frameworks that ensure scalability, security, and maintainability across all digital initiatives
  • Providing expert guidance and mentorship to develop teams, driving best practices in solution design, technology selection, and implementation
  • Collaborating with stakeholders and contributing to the university technology roadmap, championing innovation, emerging technologies, and long term strategic planning

What you will bring

You’re an experienced and forward-thinking Solution Architect with deep technical knowledge, strong leadership skills, and a collaborative approach to problem solving.  You thrive in complex environments, enjoy working across multiple business domains, and are passionate about delivering scalable, impactful technology solutions.

To succeed in this role, you will also need:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Ideally 8+ years in technical roles with at least 5 years in solution architecture
  • Proven experience in designing and integrating enterprise platforms including TechnologyOne, Dynamics 365, Blackboard, and Microsoft Teams
  • Strong understanding of solution design patterns, architectural frameworks, and integration practices
  • Demonstrate ability to lead large scale architecture initiatives and collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, translating business needs into technical strategy
  • A commitment to innovation, continuous improvement, and delivering real world impact

Why Southern Cross University

SCU is proudly a regional university, young, small and vibrant. That means you’ll find more exposure, opportunity and ownership - to grow, achieve and build a career that means more. And you’ll do it alongside passionate people and leaders who go the extra mile to help you succeed. A career with us is about more than just work. It’s about place, community and the life you want to live. With three main campuses at the Gold Coast, Coffs Harbour and the Northern Rivers region of NSW, we’re integral to all these wonderful communities. Find your place and be more in this beautiful part of the world.

Your opportunity is:

  • Full-time, continuing (permanent)
  • Located at either Coffs Harbour, NSW 2450, Gold Coast, QLD 4225, or Lismore, NSW 2480. Relocation Assistance, making it easier to join our regional communities
  • The level of appointment will be commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications, skills and experience.

You will enjoy a range of perks designed to support your wellbeing, growth and work-life balance. For more information on our benefits and what it’s like to work at SCU, visit Why work at Southern Cross University?

Be more with Southern Cross University today

Southern Cross University values potential as much as experience. If you do not meet all the listed requirements but are excited about the role and confident you can contribute, we encourage you to apply or reach out for more information.

About HUB24

At HUB24, we’re rethinking the way wealth management works, combining platform, technology and data to create better outcomes for financial professionals and their clients.

Our purpose is simple:  Empower better financial futures, together.

What sets us apart is how we work. We back bold thinking, move with pace, and turn ideas into action. You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact across your team, the business, and for the clients we support every day.

HUB24 Limited is an ASX-listed company (ASX: HUB) and part of the ASX100. We have over 1,100 employees across Australia, with offices in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth and the Gold Coast. 

Why you’ll enjoy working here

We create an environment where you can do your best work and see the impact of it.

  • Work with smart, collaborative people who get things done.

  • Your ideas won’t sit in a backlog, they’ll be heard, tested and actioned.

  • Grow your career your way, with support to learn, stretch and explore new opportunities.

We also offer benefits to support you inside and outside of work:

  • Genuinely flexible and hybrid ways of working.

  • Employee Share Scheme.

  • Additional leave and wellbeing support.

  • Enhanced parental leave and support through different life stages.

  • Everyday benefits, including discounts and financial wellbeing support.

Why this is an exciting opportunity

The IT Service Delivery team provides timely and expert technical services to support the products and services of the HUB24 Group and external clients. These include managed services and hosting, infrastructure support, application support, and end user support.
The primary objective of the Desktop Support Analyst is to deliver reliable, customer-focused workplace technology support for HUB24’s Queensland offices, ensuring incidents, service requests and end-user technology needs are resolved efficiently and in line with agreed service levels. The role acts as the local on-site technology contact for Queensland office locations, supporting desktop, device, access and collaboration services while partnering with centralised technology teams to maintain consistent, secure and compliant service delivery.

This role operates on a hybrid working arrangement, with four days per week on-site and one day working from home. The primary location is our Gold Coast office. As a key member of the support team, you will also be required to travel between our Queensland offices in Brisbane and the Gold Coast on a rotating basis to provide onsite support.

What you’ll be doing

  • Deliver high-quality end-to-end support for incidents, service requests and workplace technology issues across interstate offices, ensuring timely resolution, clear communication and adherence to service levels.

  • Act as the primary on-site technology contact, providing hands-on desktop support, troubleshooting hardware, software, workplace technology and access-related issues, and coordinating local technology needs.

  • Manage and resolve tickets through the ITSM platform, ensuring accurate categorisation, documentation, prioritisation and ownership through to resolution, with escalation to specialist teams as required.

  • Support onboarding, offboarding and access management activities, including device provisioning, system access and lifecycle management of workplace technology assets.

  • Collaborate with Service Desk, Desktop Support and Service Operations teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality user experience across all locations.

  • Create and maintain knowledge articles, documentation and operating procedures, while identifying opportunities to improve support processes, technology services and user experience.

  • Ensure compliance with IT governance, security and asset management standards, and contribute to service reporting, metrics and the identification of recurring issues and risks.

What you bring

You don’t need to tick every box, but experience in the below will set you up for success.

Experience & Skills

  • Minimum 2 years' experience in an IT Support role within a medium to large enterprise environment, supporting end-user computing and workplace technologies.

  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles, including incident, request, problem and change management, with experience using ITSM platforms.

  • Demonstrated experience providing remote and on-site technical support across hardware, software, operating systems, workplace technologies and access-related issues.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365, endpoint management (e.g. Intune), identity and access management, and modern collaboration platforms.

  • Experience supporting device provisioning, asset lifecycle management, onboarding, offboarding and user access management in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues, assess impact and deliver effective resolutions.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships, establish credibility and engage effectively with end users, stakeholders and technical teams.

  • Ability to work independently in a geographically distributed environment, manage competing priorities and maintain high service standards.

  • Experience creating and maintaining documentation, knowledge articles and standard operating procedures.

  • Understanding of IT governance, security, risk and compliance requirements, with a continuous improvement mindset and a focus on enhancing service delivery.

Our process

We aim to keep the process simple and respectful of your time:

  • You’ll receive an acknowledgement after applying.

  • Our Talent team will review your application and keep you updated.

  • If shortlisted, we’ll connect to learn more about you.

  • Interviews may be virtual or in person.

  • You’ll receive an outcome and feedback.


If you need any adjustments, please let us know - we’re here to support you.

Our commitment

We’re committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and supported to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences.

Agencies, we work with a panel of preferred suppliers and are not accepting any unsolicited CVs.

  • Set clear engineering priorities and manage delivery across multiple projects.

  • Build capability within the team through mentoring, feedback and development.

  • Partner with business leaders to translate operational needs into practical technology solutions.

  • Champion modern software development practices and AI-assisted engineering.

  • Guide technical and architectural decisions without becoming the team’s primary coder.

  • Support the continued evolution of our BuildCam platform and internal business systems.

  • Improve software delivery, quality, scalability and development processes.

  • Remove roadblocks and create an environment where engineers can perform at their best.

  • Contribute to Buildsafe’s broader technology strategy and roadmap.

About You

You’re an experienced software or engineering leader who gets genuine satisfaction from helping others succeed.You understand technology, but you also understand the business behind it. You can communicate with developers, senior leaders and operational teams and translate between technical requirements and commercial outcomes.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Experience leading software development or engineering teams.

  • Strong people leadership, coaching and mentoring capability.

  • Experience managing software delivery across multiple projects or platforms.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • A practical and commercially minded approach to technology.

  • Experience working within Agile development environments.

  • An understanding of modern software engineering and architecture principles.

  • Curiosity around emerging technology, particularly AI-assisted development.

  • The ability to balance innovation with reliable, practical business outcomes.

You’ll have the opportunity to help us modernise existing business-critical platforms while identifying new technologies and development practices that improve productivity and create competitive advantage.

This is an opportunity to join a growing Australian business where technology has a genuine seat at the table.
